drill_uniqueness_policy.source: User follow-up: Try to force unique drills; while strength lifts may recur as needed for progressions
drill_uniqueness_policy.scope: Across this twelve-class curriculum and within each class
drill_uniqueness_policy.explosiveness: Strongly prioritize unused meaningfully distinct tasks; no automatic recurring explosive anchor.
drill_uniqueness_policy.stabilization_resilience: Prefer distinct drills; recurrence allowed for an explicit strength progression or consolidation purpose while staying light.
drill_uniqueness_policy.primary_strength: Lifts may recur as needed for traceable progression, including a justified hold or regression.
drill_uniqueness_policy.uniqueness_test: Changed name, side, load, dose, surface or cosmetic grip/stance/tempo alone is insufficient; require a specific relevant change of task or force/control demand.
drill_uniqueness_policy.recurrence_exception: Identify any necessary drill recurrence and explain its concrete relevance/readiness need and alternatives considered. Never use unrelated or needlessly complex work to satisfy novelty.
drill_uniqueness_policy.feedback_rule: New drill does not imply greater demand, mastery, tolerable workload or a comparable performance test.
